card.name: Calcium and phosphate salt wording
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside names of mineral salts, especially calcium, phosphate, bicarbonate and sodium salts. It fires on links like "of", "in" and "-based" that lead into these salt names.

modes.label: Calcium-phosphate precipitate warning
modes.description: Linking words and the word calcium in the warning about calcium and phosphate forming precipitates.

modes.label: Inside salt names
modes.description: Partway through names such as sodium phosphate, bicarbonate or sodium polystyrene sulfonate.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word salt and away from unrelated word pieces, so it adds salt-related wording.
card.plain: It lights up on the words leading into mineral salt names like calcium phosphate or sodium phosphate.
